_note: Two independent inputs the chart does not have. The intrabar one is total and is what makes S7 unattainable; the news one is partial and would have been survivable on its own.

intrabar_execution_path._why: simulate_trades is handed `candles` (the raw candle file), not the detection resample. Arming, the 3-candle delay and the containment touch are minute-by-minute. A 15-minute bar carries four numbers and cannot order events inside itself.

news_calendar._why: The blackout branch sits at execution.py:2493, BEFORE the arm logic, so it gates S7 and not only S8. Pine cannot read a file.
